## Objective
- Build a complete, playable automotive company management game centered on research, vehicle design, production, hiring, marketing, sales, and year-over-year growth.

## Requirements
- Start in 2000 with $2,000.
- Provide researchers, fixers, era-locked technology research, vehicle design, factories, publicity, global expansion, named companies/models, and sales reports.
- Support responsive desktop and mobile layouts.

## Decisions
- Built as a self-contained browser game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with localStorage saving.
- Used a polished industrial, editorial dashboard visual style.
- Modeled annual revenue, payroll, factory capacity, vehicle age, campaign boosts, and four-year model lifecycles.
- Assumed an initial $650 launch cost and $2,600 first factory expansion cost.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full application shell and navigation.
- Built overview, design studio, research lab, people/sites, and market views.
- Implemented company and model naming.
- Implemented vehicle shape, size, interior, tyre, body, color, and price choices.
- Implemented era-locked research and vehicle technology unlocks.
- Implemented hiring, factories, regional expansion, and publicity campaigns.
- Implemented annual progression, salaries, sales, profitability, retirement, and reports.
- Added responsive mobile navigation and local saving.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser and verify interactions and layout.
2. Test localStorage saving, year advancement, launch costs, and model retirement.
3. Fix any browser-visible issues found during validation.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main application structure and navigation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Complete responsive visual system and page styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: All gameplay logic, state, rendering, and interactions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: Existing project information.

## Important Context
- Save data is stored under `motorhaus-save-v1` in localStorage.
- The game has no external build step and can be served as static files.
- `game.js` contains the main state object, technology tree, vehicle classes, and all advance-year calculations.
